title: Warehouse Transfer Form
subtitle: Warehouse Transfer: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Warehouse Transfer Form covers inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting. The inventory transfer coordinator records Warehouse Transfer activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Warehouse Transfer Form keeps Warehouse Transfer exceptions visible until the inventory transfer coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Warehouse Transfer Form at source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse. Document inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting identity before Warehouse Transfer begins. Compare inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting findings with stated Warehouse Transfer criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Transfer issues to warehouse control reviewer.

sections.title: Operating context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Transfer, identify responsible parties, source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse, and the linked inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting source.

fields.label: Item, lot, serial, quantity, and unit of measure
Source, destination, handling-unit, and seal identifiers

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Transfer facts for inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Operating exception, outcome, and review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Warehouse Transfer conditions; have inventory transfer coordinator assign the next Warehouse Transfer owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Wrong item, lot, serial, or destination
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Transfer when physical quantity, identity, custody, destination receipt, or system posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Transfer proof and route unresolved inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting scope to inventory transfer coordinator.
